notes.title: Patchnotes: Alpha14
notes.content:
Hello merchant!

The update is finally here!
We have reworked the level-design as well as the heroes' combat mechanics. Now you can see fights with a "brand new" UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/db3f8f239e5d2c77d4af26dffc8f95e9315a9ac1.png[/img]


The whole level-design has been reworked with a bigger map (which will allow us to add more story and quest elements later on). The crypt has also been completely reworked with some new surprises :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/685d5e09cd1066a548ab217f8e5014f3e11968fc.png[/img]


Known problems:

- pathfinding with heroes
- guard stop patrolling
- the mouse can be offset
- environment bug (the game looks too "white")

notes.title: Dev Diary 4: Competition and city progress
notes.content:
Hello, merchant!

[h2]Competition[/h2]

You are no longer the only one who can sell equipment to heroes...
Now guilds (especially adventuring guilds) are able to buy stores and supply them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/e81db462d9ca6e01f4cc08b5b7aa06b771bb31bc.png[/img]

Heroes will have to choose a store to buy their favorite equipment. Your reputation (among classes and your alignment) will now have an impact on this decision!

You can now view some sales information in the new city interface

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/cec07b88735be6969ae3d9075badbc4551dfac23.png[/img]


[h2]City Progression[/h2]

The town progression mechanic has been reworked: previously heroes had to complete the first dungeon quest to unlock level 2 of the town. 

We want the player to have more freedom in his evolution (including preventing the success of this quest, which will make sense in a future story update... Thanks for reading this dev diary so far ;-) )

From now on the player will have to accomplish a certain number of objectives to make the city evolve. You can see this information in the new city interface:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/1977d848c983b7e83036b98d83a2f9e545ea2085.png[/img]

You will be able to unlock new recipes with unique formula (They modify finals characteristics). As a new skill which create a semi-random recipe based on your shop alignements:

Now swords have semi-random visuals based on theirs alignements

About futur, we planned for post EA release to add an equivalent system on magicals staffs, basic visuals for armors. Also we would like to rework some characteristics like armor for damage reduction; luck for drop, critical, dodge and so on…


Please note that each presented feature will be included in the next Early-Access release ! We will communicate the date soon …

notes.title: Dev Diary 01: Heroes
notes.content:
[h1]Dev Diary 01: Heroes[/h1]

Hello, merchant!

Welcome to our first dev diary !

The town of Phenistoria is inhabited by many heroes who pledge their allegiance to various guilds. Every hero has a unique set of stats and traits that determine their behavior. As a freshly starting merchant, your encounter with heroes will determine your future prosperity. These encounters evolve around one major aspect of the game : reciprocity. The way you choose to play the game will influence the world, and so will affect their behavior. The question is: what kind of merchant do you want to be ?

[h2]Hero traits[/h2]
The new hero traits system will both influence the heroes’ stats and their behaviors.
Each hero will start with some traits (around 3 at the moment) and can lose or gain some during the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/5fe4fced1d04f9deb9fe7ad6ef724520d2bbbcc4.png[/img]
[i]Are you sure you want to recruit her?[/i]

We are currently working on a new behavior system. At the moment the system is a binary “if/else” script. We intend to extend it with a “behavior tree” that will provide new interesting combinations.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39750128/540d8873af7badc354a57ff9405fdc2ef0d1b737.png[/img]
[i]Very WIP new behavior tree system and yes, we are using Godot engine[/i]

Soon, heroes will be able to do “actions” (Like “assassination”, “training” or “brawl”...) determined adequately by the new behavior system through the account of the traits and heroes’ alignment (order/neutral/chaos and good/neutral/bad).


Those features are planned to be released in early 2022 (roadmap incoming)


In the next dev diary, we will introduce the guilds.
